resources.string: Your accounts stay on this device. Use a password of at least 10 characters and keep an encrypted backup. A lost password cannot be recovered.
Device authentication enabled. Keep your vault password for recovery.
Scan an OTP QR. Google exports are imported one QR at a time; scan every QR in the export.
Camera unavailable. You can add an account manually.
Add your first account with a QR code or a secret key.

Remove this account from the list? You will need its secret or an encrypted backup to restore it. The encrypted vault retains deleted entries for compatibility; entries older than 90 days are purged on a later save. Existing backup files are unaffected.

Re-enter your vault password after selecting the file. Choose a separate backup password (10+ characters). Only encrypted data is exported. Cancelled or failed writes may leave a partial file; export again.

For a new v2 vault, the backup password becomes the vault password. A v1 backup needs a new vault password. Older backups can reset HOTP counters and reuse codes; check with the service before generating codes. Restoring disables device authentication; enable it again after checking your accounts.
Replace deletes current accounts and can reset HOTP counters to older backup values. This may reuse codes.
QR imported. Check all imported accounts before use.
Backup restored. Check account counts and HOTP counters.
Incorrect password or damaged encrypted data.
Device key unavailable. Use the vault password.
Device authentication cancelled or unavailable. Use the vault password.
Could not complete this operation. Check the input, file, or storage space. Your existing vault is retained; unlock again if needed.
Use copied codes within 30 seconds. Android restrictions or app termination can delay automatic clearing.
